newsitem.title: ITALY: MontePaschi okays stake purchase in SPaolo.
newsitem.headline: MontePaschi okays stake purchase in SPaolo.

text.p: The board of Italy's Monte dei Paschi di Siena has approved the purchase of a three percent stake in Istituto Bancario San Paolo, a spokesman for MontePaschi said on Thursday.
MontePaschi aimed as a result of the purchase to become part of a hard core of shareholders with significant stakes in the Turin-based bank which is due to be privatised later this year.
The MontePaschi board also called a meeting of the executive committee on April 14 to look at the planned share purchase in detail.
